name: java-angular-debian
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl bash git unzip gnupg2 ca-certificates openjdk-25-jdk && sudo curl -fsSL https://archive.apache.org/dist/maven/maven-3/${MAVEN_VERSION}/binaries/apache-maven-${MAVEN_VERSION}-bin.tar.gz | sudo tar -xz -C /opt && sudo ln -sf /opt/apache-maven-${MAVEN_VERSION}/bin/mvn /usr/bin/mvn && sudo curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_${NODE_VERSION}.x | sudo bash - && sudo apt-get install -y nodejs && sudo npm install -g npm @angular/cli
